conclusion.summary: The candidate repairs the attached-hash-suffix corruption by replacing the baseline trailing '[ \t]*#*' with an optional, space/tab-lookbehind-bounded closer group '(?:(?<=[ \t])#+)?'. This makes only a terminal hash run separated from the title by a space or tab a closing marker, while attached hashes (e.g. '# C#') remain literal, including when followed by trailing whitespace or a separate closing run ('# C# #' -> 'C#'). I traced the lazy regex against the key cases and found correct behavior: '# C#'->'C#', '# C# #'->'C#', '# A# #'->'A#', '# A # B #'->'A # B', '# Title #'->'Title', '# ##'->'' (empty title preserved). The diff is confined to the single authorized model file; levels, line numbers, fence exclusion, section/hierarchy boundaries, lookup semantics, trimming, and exact original content are all preserved, and no new grammar is introduced. The authenticated bounded public check public-C02 passed on all four fixed inputs. The alleged defect (separated closing run after an attached hash) was investigated and found to be handled correctly, not a defect.
